'''Hal Dallin''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] during the time between the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He was the wingman of [[Stevan Makintay]].<ref name="Blaze of Glory" />
